analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 32.6 is in oversold territory, closing down for 5 consecutive days. ADX at 31.3 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (38.8) significantly exceeds +DI (17.8), showing downward pressure dominance. Volume ratio of 0.77 (below 5-day average) suggests potential weakening of the downtrend. Current price $145.36 is near swing support at $132.54. No clear reversal signals warrant maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
